title: Why 60 FPS Can Still Stutter
description:
A 60 FPS counter can look perfect while one long frame makes the game feel rough. This short animation shows what frame pacing measures, why 16.7 milliseconds matters at 60 FPS and how one 40 millisecond hitch can hide inside a healthy average.

Sources:
https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/unreal-engine/smooth-frame-rate-in-unreal-engine
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/direct3ddxgi/dxgi-flip-model

Visuals: original Pulse Gaming diagrams.
Narration: generated locally with Kokoro TTS.
Music: an original ElevenLabs sound-effects bed licensed for finished editorial video.
Synthetic media disclosure: Yes.
